q-80060.name: Question 1
q-80060.worked_solution:
First, we move all of the terms to the left-hand side and then factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}2s+5{s}^{2} & =s+4{s}^{2} \\ 2s+5{s}^{2}-(s+4{s}^{2}) & =0 \\ 2s+5{s}^{2}-s-4{s}^{2} & =0 \\ (5{s}^{2}-4{s}^{2})+(2s-s) & =0 \\ {s}^{2}+s & =0 \\ s(s+1) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the zero product rule to get

$$
s=0\,\text{or}\,s+1=0,
$$

which in turn gives

$$
s=0\,\text{or}\,s=-1.
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $s=-1,0.$

q-223729.name: Question 2
q-223729.problem:
In **ascending order**, the solutions to $5{p}^{2}=3p$ are $p=${{field-1}} and $p=$
{{field-2}}.
q-223729.worked_solution:
First, we move all of the terms to the left-hand side and then factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}5{p}^{2} & =3p \\ 5{p}^{2}-3p & =0 \\ p(5p-3) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

So, by the zero product rule, we have

$$
p=0\,\text{or}\,5p-3=0,
$$

which in turn gives

$$
p=0\,\text{or}\,p=\frac{3}{5}.
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $p=0$ and $p=\frac{3}{5}.$

q-223793.name: Question 3
q-223793.problem:
In **ascending order**, the solutions to $-7{d}^{2}=-49d$ are $d=${{field-1}} and $d=$
{{field-2}}.
q-223793.worked_solution:
First, we move all of the terms to the left-hand side and then factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}-7{d}^{2} & =-49d \\ -7{d}^{2}+49d & =0 \\ -7d(d-7) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we apply the zero product rule to get

$$
-7d=0\,\text{or}\,d-7=0,
$$

which in turn gives

$$
d=0\,\text{or}\,d=7.
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $d=0$ and $d=7.$
